cohort: 109 multiparous Caucasian women recruited from antenatal outpatient clinics in northern Poland, divided into groups based on previous mode of birth (cesarean section or vaginal delivery).
finding: Women with a history of cesarean section had a significantly higher likelihood of excessive gestational body mass gain and were more likely to undergo another cesarean delivery in subsequent pregnancies, but no significant differences were found in insufficient GBMG or physical activity levels.
mod_finding: Women with a history of cesarean section were more likely to undergo another cesarean delivery in subsequent pregnancies.
